name: VS-Splat
definition: A feed-forward framework for 3D object reconstruction from sparse-view 2D images that uses a coarse-to-fine (C2F) approach. It predicts one coarse Gaussian primitive per voxel, learns a voxel-wise selection mask to identify object voxels, and generates multiple fine Gaussian primitives only within selected voxels.
summary: VS-Splat is a feed-forward framework for 3D reconstruction that uses voxel-level selection before generating fine primitives, enabling adaptive density control without auxiliary supervision.
